description:
Browse what Kromatic has when the user wants to see the options rather than answer a specific question: every downloadable template, the method pages of The Real Startup Book, Kromatic's other MCP servers (Fermi for estimates, Neumann for Monte Carlo simulation) or the agent skills list.

Call it with {} for an overview of every group with counts and examples, or filter to page through one group, e.g. {"resource_types": ["Download"]}, {"resource_types": ["Book Section"]}, {"resource_types": ["MCP Server"]}, {"resource_types": ["Skill"]}. Returns titles, ids, kromatic.com urls and types, not the content. No sign-in needed.

Next: pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page, or call read_resource with an item's id.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Items per page when filtering, 1 to 100 (default 50).
limit.title: Limit

resource_types.description: Optional. Only these types. Leave both filters empty for the overview. Book Section = a method page of The Real Startup Book. Download = a template or worksheet; Download File = one file inside it. Tool = the full guide text for one of Kromatic's interactive web apps (e.g. Experiment Calculator, Startup Poker); Tools / Games = the website's link entry for the same apps, with less text. Prefer Tool when you want content.
resource_types.title: Resource Types

source_keys.description: Optional. Only these sources: real_startup_book (method pages), blog_content (Kromatic blog), learning_library (courses, lessons, templates, and the MCP Server and Skill entries), tools_and_games.
source_keys.title: Source Keys

name: list_resources
title: List resources
